description: cislunar-sim physics engine external validation benchmarks. See src/cislunar/validation/physics_benchmark.py for methodology and citations.

benchmarks.name: Sail characteristic acceleration (McInnes Table 2.1)
benchmarks.notes: Ideal sail (boom_shadow=0), rho=0.9999, 1 AU, normal-facing, A=1 m², m=1 kg; ~0.5% residual from solar constant (1361 vs McInnes ~1368 W/m²)

benchmarks.name: Eclipse fraction at 400 km (Bate/Mueller/White cylindrical formula)
benchmarks.source: Bate, Mueller & White (1971) Appendix; cylindrical shadow, β=0
benchmarks.notes: r=6771.0 km; ISS observational range 37–40% consistent

benchmarks.name: J2 RAAN precession vs. Brouwer theory (400 km, i=51.6°)
benchmarks.notes: 24-hour simulation; coast; J2-only gravity; atan2 RAAN unwrapped

benchmarks.name: Ephemeris Moon LUT interpolation vs. direct astropy (2025-01-01)
benchmarks.source: astropy built-in DE430; same source as LUT
benchmarks.notes: Moon geocentric dist: 381.738 Mm; 50 km << 5 km gate (interpolation accuracy only)

benchmarks.name: Three-body specific energy drift over 24 h (LEO, Earth+Moon+Sun)
benchmarks.notes: Drift is physical (Moon+Sun perturbation); >0.01% indicates integrator error, not physics

benchmarks.name: Lunar J2 RAAN precession at 100 km, i=45° (Brouwer)
benchmarks.source: [Brouwer1959] Eq. 40 applied to Moon; J2+J3 gravity
benchmarks.notes: RAAN used (arg. perigee undefined for circular orbit); 5% tol for J3+mascon noise

benchmarks.name: Lunar gravity force ordering at 200 km (J2 > J3 > mascon)
benchmarks.notes: J2=3.19e-04  J3=1.20e-04  mascon=5.64e-05 m/s²  ordering=OK  mag=OK

benchmarks.name: Low lunar orbit energy conservation (100 km, J2+J3+mascons, 1 period)
benchmarks.source: Integrator correctness criterion; full perturbation model
benchmarks.notes: Drift is physical; >0.005% indicates integrator error at Moon

benchmarks.name: CheckpointEvent timing accuracy (zero-gravity straight line)
benchmarks.notes: gate_dist=30 km, gate_r=25 km, speed=3 km/s → t=1.667 s

benchmarks.name: SurfaceEvent timing accuracy (zero-gravity radial fall)
benchmarks.notes: gap=2000 m, speed=500 m/s → t=4.0 s

benchmarks.name: EclipseEvent timing vs. analytical shadow entry (500 km orbit)
benchmarks.unit: s (shadow entry time from step start)

benchmarks.name: Sail-power coupling: P_solar ∝ cos(θ) at 45° tilt
benchmarks.source: PowerBudgetModel: P_solar = flux × A × η × cos(θ_array)
benchmarks.notes: P_solar_max=45.73 W; P_solar_45=32.34 W; expected=32.34 W

benchmarks.name: Eclipse thrust gate: P_thruster = 0 in full shadow, empty battery
Penumbra: shadow_fraction() ∈ (0, 1) at geometric midpoint
benchmarks.source: Conical shadow geometry; R_SUN from eclipse.py

benchmarks.name: Angular momentum conservation, pure two-body, 3 days (400 km LEO)
benchmarks.source: Exact integral of two-body problem; Battin [1999] §1

benchmarks.name: Multi-day cislunar energy drift, 3 days (Earth+Moon+Sun, LEO)
benchmarks.notes: Drift is physical (Moon+Sun perturbation); >0.05% over 3 days indicates integrator error

benchmarks.name: GTO initial state: apogee speed from make_lunar_craft vs vis-viva
benchmarks.source: Vis-viva equation; Ariane 5 GTO (185 km × 35,786 km)
benchmarks.notes: e_ref=0.7308; e_meas=0.7308; r_apo_ref=42.157 Mm; r_meas=42.157 Mm

benchmarks.name: Trajectory convergence: 60 s vs 10 s step, 3-day cislunar
